{{Quote|I've got good suppliers, only the best sold here.|Medliuna|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Medliuna''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war, she worked as a merchant in the market area of [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> an industrial town controlled by a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]<ref name="CodexJiguuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. Medliuna sold various types of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] at the stall although she had a number of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] parts around the stall as well, however she did not offer these for sale.<ref name="SWTOR" /> As all merchants in Jiguuna were, Medliuna was expected to pay some of his profits from his stall to one of Nem'ro's lieutenants at the crime lord's [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]].<ref name="CodexNem'roP">{{TORcite|type=codex|Nem'ro's palace}}</ref> Whilst at the stall she wore brown hooded armor and a backpack. The Mirialan had a bald head, blue eyes and green skin. Like many of her [[Species/Legends|species]] at the time,<ref name="CodexMirialan">{{TORcite|type=codex|Mirialan}}</ref> Medliuna's face was decorated with [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] which consisted of three lines made of triangles of alternate orientation. One of these was postioned beneath each of her eyes and the third down the center of her forehead.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Medliuna first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. She appears as a medium armor vendor on the planet Nal Hutta, the starting planet for players of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Imperial Agent]] class.
